notes.title: Minor Update: Patch 1.01
notes.notes:
Minor fixes to Wick: No Way Out.

- Stopped Benny from sliding on his face when he goes to sleep.
- Fixed translation error in Spanish when unlocking No Way Out content.
- Fixed mouse and keyboard menu controls from conflicting.
- Fixed button positioning in some menus.
- Fixed collision of some of the in-game props.
